_doc: Real Miracles voice cast (docs/miracles/VOICE.md). Schema: tools/story/voice.py docstring; pitch pinning (f0Hz) from voice_extras.py / voice_exodus.py, crowd takes from voice_jonah.py's wrapper.

narrator.instruct: 一位温暖的女讲故事人，像妈妈在床边给四到十岁的孩子讲圣经故事，声音亲切、生动、自然，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。这一句：
narrator.why: the family storyteller (Qwen vivian), same as every pack

jesus.design: 男性，三十岁左右，嗓音温暖、清亮、柔和圆润，干净不沙哑，平静从容，亲切又带一点点俏皮的笑意，吐字清楚，像一位温柔的好老师，从不吼叫。普通话标准。
jesus.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，自然不做作，有真实的呼吸，语速正常流畅，不拖沓。声音温暖友好，让孩子喜欢，不吓人。这一句：

peter.design: 男性，四十多岁，身材高大魁梧的渔夫，低沉浑厚的男低音，胸腔共鸣很重，嗓门大但声音低，豪爽爱笑，热心肠，像一只友好的大熊。就算大喊大叫也是低沉的大嗓门，从不尖细。普通话标准。
peter.instruct: 像真人在给四到十岁的孩子演圣经故事广播剧，夸张好笑，但是不吓人，有真实的呼吸。大喊时声音也保持低沉。这一句：
peter.why: 2026-11-18: designed bass, pinned 95-135 Hz; first design ('loud, quick to shout') came out 240-360 Hz when shouting, re-described as a low booming bass (Jonah captain lesson)

man.design: 男性，二十五岁左右的年轻人，声音轻柔、略带腼腆，清澈明亮，真诚，高兴起来会变得激动欢快。普通话标准。

narrator.instruct: A warm woman storyteller, like a mother at a child's bedside telling a Bible story to a child of four to ten: friendly, lively, natural, at a natural flowing pace, never dragging. This line:
narrator.why: the family storyteller in English (Qwen vivian)

jesus.design: A man of about thirty with a warm, clear, soft and round voice, clean and never hoarse, calm and unhurried, kind with a hint of playful smile, crisp diction, like a gentle teacher who never shouts. Clear standard American English.
jesus.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. Warm and friendly, lovable to young children, never scary. This line:

peter.design: A man in his forties, a big burly fisherman with a deep, booming bass voice, heavy chest resonance, loud but low, hearty and quick to laugh, warm-hearted like a friendly bear. Even when he shouts his voice stays deep and never turns shrill. Standard American English.
peter.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: comic and big, never scary, with real breaths. Keep the voice deep and low even when shouting. This line:
peter.why: 2026-11-18: designed bass, pinned 95-135 Hz; first design ('loud, quick to shout') came out 240-360 Hz when shouting, re-described as a low booming bass (Jonah captain lesson)

man.design: A young man of about twenty-five, a soft, slightly shy, clear, bright and sincere voice that turns excited and joyful when he is happy. Standard American English.
man.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. Warm and friendly, lovable to young children, never scary. This line:

friend2.instruct: Like a real actor in a children's Bible radio play for ages 4 to 10: natural, with real breaths, at a natural flowing pace. Warm and friendly, lovable to young children, never scary. This line:

mi_01.m: 讲故事的开头，明亮亲切；“屋里屋外都是人”越说越快、一个叠一个
mi_01.m_en: storyteller opening, bright; speed up and pile on 'people everywhere'

mi_02.m: 温暖简单，对着众人微笑，不说教
mi_02.m_en: warm and simple, smiling at the people; not preachy

mi_03.m: 温暖，说到“只能天天躺在褥子上”时有点心疼
mi_03.m_en: warm, a little tender on 'every day he had to lie'

mi_04.m: 明亮，抬着人喘着气；“一定”说得毫不怀疑
mi_04.m_en: bright, panting a little from carrying; total certainty

mi_05.m: 小声，害羞，带一点紧张的小笑
mi_05.m_en: small, shy, a nervous little laugh

mi_06.m: 礼貌又满怀希望，最后一声“哎哟”被挤得滑稽地弹回来
mi_06.m_en: polite and hopeful, then a comic 'oof' as he bounces off the crowd

phrases.instruct: 被弹回来，滑稽的一声“哎哟”。

zh.asrIgnore: 哎哟|唉哟|哎呦|唉呦|哎呀

mi_07.m: 一群人，七嘴八舌，抱怨但不凶，互相重叠
mi_07.m_en: crowd of 8-10, grumbly but not nasty, overlapping

mi_08.m: 高大憨厚的朋友，边想边说，“嗯”拖得很长
mi_08.m_en: big slow friend, thinking out loud, long 'hmm'

phrases.instruct: 拖得很长的一声“嗯”，边想边说。

phrases.text: we can't get in the door...

mi_09.m: 突然想到好主意，竖起手指；“有了”前先倒吸一口气
mi_09.m_en: sudden bright idea, finger up; a little gasp before 'I've got it'

phrases.instruct: 突然灵光一闪，倒吸一口气后大叫。
sudden bright idea, a gasp then a shout.

phrases.text: We'll go in through the roof!

mi_10.m: 稳稳地，跟着他们一步一步有点喘；后半句讲解，友好
mi_10.m_en: steady, a bit breathless with them on 'step by step'; then explaining, friendly

mi_11.m: 四个朋友一起，欢快有节奏的干活号子
mi_11.m_en: the four friends together, a cheerful work chant, rhythmic

mi_12.m: 大喊大叫的滑稽慌张，“哎”一声比一声高；“我的屋顶”几乎是哭腔，好笑
mi_12.m_en: big comic panic; rising 'hey' three times; 'My roof!' almost a wail, funny

phrases.instruct: 惊讶地大喊，一声比一声高，越来越慌，但嗓音低沉。
几乎哭出来的哀嚎，滑稽。
rising each time, more and more panicked.

mi_13.m: 觉得好笑，温暖地笑一声，温和地逗彼得；“有人来了”带着好奇
mi_13.m_en: amused, warm chuckle; gentle teasing to Peter; curious on 'someone's coming'

phrases.instruct: 温和地逗他，最后带着好奇。
gently teasing, curious at the end.

mi_14.m: 压低声音，悬念；“慢慢地、慢慢地”拉长；“耶稣面前”轻轻落下
mi_14.m_en: hushed and suspenseful; stretch 'slowly... slowly'; land softly on 'in front of Jesus'

mi_15.m: 温暖、慢，“真的相信”带一点笑意
mi_15.m_en: warm and slow; a small smile in the voice on 'trusted Him'

mi_16.m: 非常温柔，贴近，像父亲，不急
mi_16.m_en: very tender, close, like a father; unhurried

mi_17.m: “嘀咕”时声音低一点，有点神秘，然后恢复平常
mi_17.m_en: a touch of mystery on the grumble (lower voice), then plain

mi_18.m: 平静清楚，对着整个屋子；破折号处停一下
mi_18.m_en: calm, clear, to the whole room; a pause at the dash

mi_19.m: 喜悦的命令，明亮有力，带着笑，不是吼
mi_19.m_en: joyful command, bright and strong, a smile in it; not shouted

mi_20.m: 从不敢相信到大笑：结巴、倒吸一口气，然后“我能走了”纯粹的喜悦
mi_20.m_en: disbelief to laughter: stammer, a gasp, then pure joy on 'I can walk'

phrases.instruct: 低头看着自己的腿，倒吸一口气。
looking down at his legs, a gasp.

mi_21.m: 一群人，惊讶，七嘴八舌的惊叹，夹着小孩子的“哇”
mi_21.m_en: crowd of 8-10, amazed, overlapping gasps and a child's 'wow'

mi_23.m: 先放声大笑，然后摇着头，开心极了
mi_23.m_en: big hearty laugh first, then shaking his head, delighted

zh.say: 哈哈哈！好吧好吧——这个洞，挖得值！

en.say: Ha ha ha! All right, all right... that hole was worth it!

phrases.instruct: shaking his head, giving in, laughing.

mi_24.m: 平静的傍晚，声音像湖水一样轻轻起伏
mi_24.m_en: calm, evening voice, a gentle lilt like the water

mi_26.m: 紧张刺激，越说越快，有点喘；“大风暴”说得很重
mi_26.m_en: exciting, faster, a little breathless; big on 'huge storm'

mi_27.m: 滑稽的慌张，顶着风大喊，上气不接下气；“不行啦”声音发抖
mi_27.m_en: comic panic, shouting over the wind, breathless; voice wobbles on 'no good'

mi_28.m: 惊慌，使劲摇醒他；最后一句又委屈又害怕，不是生气
mi_28.m_en: frantic, shaking Him; the last question hurt and scared, not angry

phrases.instruct: 又委屈又害怕，声音发抖，不是生气。
hurt and scared, voice trembling, not angry.

mi_29.m: 坚定有力但不生气；“安静吧”之前稍停一下，然后变轻
mi_29.m_en: firm and strong but not angry; a small pause before 'be still', then soft

phrases.instruct: 坚定、有力、有权柄，但不生气，不吼叫。
稍停之后，温柔下来，像对孩子说的“嘘”。
firm, strong, with authority, but not angry, not shouting.
after a small pause, softer, calming.

mi_30.m: 非常温柔，带一点微笑，像朋友，不是责备
mi_30.m_en: very gentle, a small smile, like a friend; not a telling-off

mi_31.m: 先是敬畏的小声自言自语，然后“连风和浪”带着惊叹放大声
mi_31.m_en: awed whisper to himself, then louder with wonder on 'even the wind'

phrases.text: Even the wind and the waves do what He says!
phrases.instruct: louder and louder, full of wonder.

mi_32.m: 温暖的道理，直接对孩子说；最后一句慢而清楚
mi_32.m_en: warm moral, straight to the child; slow and clear on the last sentence

mi_33.m: 鼓励，带着微笑；“四个好朋友”声音扬起来
mi_33.m_en: encouraging, a smile; lift on 'four good friends'
